title: autoswitch: confirm size M, plan, team models
body:
autoswitch: confirm size M, plan, team models
**Size M** (qa full, design no): ~3 tasks in series, one path, CLI behaviour change, no risk flag. Plan in `scopes/autoswitch/iterations/1.md`.

**Findings:** source of truth is `tools/claude-accounts/` in the squad repo (ADR 0012), not `~/.claude-accounts` (installed copies). `project.md` fixed. Today `cautoswitch` restarts EVERY off-default pane one by one (7 panes in 107 s on 10-22), and a message to a pane mid-restart fails with no retry. Waking all (earlier plan) = a cold-cache turn x N agents.

**Plan:**
- 01 Dev design note: how to detect a pane's pending work (herdr status, message newer than its last turn, failed-send marker); cost of a bare `--resume`; lazy vs eager. Probes use stubs/dry-run only. Agreed with QA whitebox.
- 02 `cautoswitch`/`cswitch`: set the workspace default as now; move and wake only panes with pending work; `cwake` is idle-gated, one short prompt, after the batch; `CSWITCH_WAKE` override.
- 03 Tests (`tests/test_ca_*`, stub harness), `HANDOFF.md`, README, skill. May merge into 02.

**Open choice:** an idle pane on the exhausted account with no pending work. Recommend leave it (zero tokens; re-checked every tick; moved when work arrives). Alternative: move silently without a prompt.

**Deploy:** you run `install.sh` after merge; the squad never edits the live home.

**Team (defaults, advisor opus on, read-only):**
| Role | Model | Effort |
|---|---|---|
| Developer | sonnet | medium |
| QA whitebox | sonnet | high |
| QA blackbox | sonnet | high |
| Manager | sonnet | high |
Keep or change any row. Token Coach runs at close.
options: (a) confirm plan as written, keep default models; (b) confirm, change some models; (c) change plan
rec: (a), and leave idle no-work panes on their account (lazy switch)

text: The plan is okay, but I would to pick the alternative: move silently without a prompt

title: autoswitch 02: QA blackbox cannot run the build
body:
autoswitch 02: QA blackbox cannot run the build
QA blackbox (accounts-qab-autoswitch) is blocked on 02 (sha 0f80fe5): its settings deny Read of `.worktrees/**` and allow only git/bash -n/py_compile, so it cannot run `cautoswitch`/`cwake` on the stub harness. It sent no verdict and will not work around the deny.

I exported the sha to `/tmp/qab-02/` (outside worktrees; code under `tools/claude-accounts/`, tests next to it). Nothing live is touched: stub herdr, temp HOME.

(a) QA-b runs the stub harness from `/tmp/qab-02/`; each Bash command it needs shows as a permission prompt in its pane for you to approve. Keeps the blackbox check. Recommended.
(b) Drop QA-b for 02 (SIZE-20): QA whitebox also does the behaviour check. Needs your OK because 02 changes CLI/log output people see.

Reply (a) or (b). On (a) I tell QA-b to use the /tmp copy.
options: (a) approve QA-b's Bash prompts for running the stub harness on a /tmp copy; (b) drop QA-b for 02, QA whitebox does the behaviour check
blocks: task 02 done, then 03 and the merge+install

reason: Settled: QA-b uses Dev's stub harness on /tmp copy (cautoswitch cannot be isolated from live /proc); its test-run prompts reach the PO directly.

title: autoswitch: done, merged, installed; confirm close
body:
autoswitch: done, merged, installed; confirm close
**Done (all three tasks passed both checkers; QA-b n/a for doc-only 01):**
- 01 design note: dac0c50, evidence/01/ (in scope folder).
- 02 cautoswitch + cwake: 3ce1fba, tasks/02/evidence.md, evidence/02/qa-w.md, qa-b.md.
- 03 docs (HANDOFF, README, skill): bc4e1e7, tasks/03/evidence.md.
- Suite on a clean clone of bc4e1e7 with --tz: 1523 tests, 0 fail (evidence/suite-tz.txt).

**Merged and installed as you asked:** main = 69eb078 (`git merge --no-ff`, parent bc4e1e7). `install.sh --dry-run`, then `--force`: live files now symlink into tools/claude-accounts/ (incl. new cwake); backups in ~/.claude-accounts/.install-backup/. Branches squad/accounts/autoswitch/accounts-dev-autoswitch-1/-2/-3 are contained in main; none unmerged.

**Your steps:**
1. Restart `cautoswitch` in its tab (it still runs the old code).
2. Optional live probe, checklist in HANDOFF.md: compare `squad-usage` before/after on one idle pane. Clause 2 (real failed SendMessage) and bare `--resume` cost stay unverified until then.
3. Confirm the close (a/b above). I then run squad-close.

**Friction:** QA-b could not isolate cautoswitch (it reads live /proc) so it passed 02 and 03 on the Dev's stub harness from a /tmp export. QA-w failed each task once (fixtures, failure shape, checklist wording). Details: iterations/1.summary.md.

**Process:** no rule changes made (squad is composed from the plugin). Coach proposals (stub shapes from a real sample; doc-only ticket needs QA-w alone, your call as it lowers the QA bar; QA-b ready before HANDIN) and 4 plugin proposals are drafted in scopes/autoswitch/tasks/plugin-followups.md (full report: iterations/1.coach.md). No role-instruction changes proposed.
options: (a) close the scope now; (b) keep it open until the live probe is done
rec: (a), probe is yours and needs no squad
